topic: prefill gap analysis: where the remaining 32% sits, and why ad-hoc sweeps cannot resolve it
interpretation: the candidate does ~1.63x the vendor vector work, so instruction count is part of the gap
the candidate also overlaps its DMA worse (mte2 64.5% vs 90.5% of a longer window), so overlap is the other part
a perfectly overlapped candidate at this op count would land near 69 us, i.e. about parity; there is real headroom but not from a single lever

sweep_result.conclusion: inconclusive - see the measurement discrepancy below

gate_measurement.note: 15 quiet paired windows, the authoritative number

ad_hoc_remeasurement.note: single fresh process, same archived candidate

measurement_discrepancy.conclusion: ad-hoc scripts differ from the audited window by about 10% in ratio, so they cannot resolve a 2% variant difference and must not be used to claim an improvement or a ceiling. Only the gated paired window is authoritative.

status: no prefill improvement established this round; decode EXCEED from R48 stands
not_proven: no variant is shown to beat r8s2; prefill parity is not reached
